$comment: DP-CORE cost-store snapshot — TypeScript writes {version, entries: UsageEntry[]}; Python CostStore reads same file via CLI. Schema accepts both shapes and superset for cross-language seam.
title: CostStoreSnapshot
description: Snapshot written by src/engine/usage.ts (DP-CORE W6) and rendered by src/cost/cli.py. TS shape is {version, entries}, Python shape is {version, records, totals_by_provider, global_totals}; superset with both is valid.

entries.description: DP-CORE entries written by recordUsage — each counted via src/context count()

records.description: Python CostStore records — optional superset compat
